issuing_body: U.S. Attorney's Office, District of Minnesota
title: Six Additional Defendants Charged, One Defendant Pleads Guilty in Ongoing Fraud Schemes
notes: USAO-MN primary government release recording Asha Farhan Hassan's guilty plea before U.S. District Judge David Doty. The release states the plea was to one count of wire fraud for her role in the previously charged schemes; capture the plea agreement/judgment separately if allocation of admitted amounts between programs becomes material.
supports: On December 18, 2025, Asha Farhan Hassan pleaded guilty before U.S. District Judge David Doty to one count of wire fraud.
USAO-MN reiterates that Hassan had been charged in September 2025 in a $14 million autism-fraud scheme and in the Feeding Our Future scheme, for which the release states she received $465,000.
The release states Hassan was to be sentenced at a later date.
does_not_support: A scheme-wide Feeding Our Future conviction ordinal for Hassan.
That the $14 million autism amount is part of Feeding Our Future.
